mode: Retained-evidence coverage review; no application/device test rerun and no remote write

coverage.missingMetricsExplanation: Native configs set collectCoverage=false; Chromium and manual simulator runs have no instrumented coverage. Shared 96.14% line coverage cannot be attributed to each platform.
coverage.gateScope: 90/80/90/90 thresholds apply separately to src/api, src/marketplace, src/auth and src/format.ts, not whole-app UI.

backendContext.note: coverage.py native report measures executable statements/lines and branches; 94.39% is their combined metric, not line-only coverage. PostgreSQL-specific collection can leave SQLite branches unhit; this is not evidence those branches have never been tested.

coverage.instrumentationBoundary: All frontend file percentages and uncovered branches below come only from the shared NORMAL Jest regression instrumentation. Defect, native, browser and manual executions are not merged into this coverage. An unhit branch here does not prove it was never exercised elsewhere.
